githubNotice.title: Reports are public on GitHub
githubNotice.description: You need a GitHub account to submit. You can review and edit everything before the issue is published.

privacy.title: Protect your privacy
privacy.description: Remove names, email addresses, amounts, receipts, group links, invitation tokens, and other private data before submitting.

diagnostics.title: Safe diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Copy this technical context into a bug report if it is relevant. It excludes account data, form contents, URL identifiers, query strings, and invitation tokens.
diagnostics.copyFailed: Clipboard access failed. Select and copy the diagnostics manually.

ExpenseReport.title: Expense report
ExpenseReport.noExpensesLabel: No expenses in the selected period.
ExpenseReport.noParticipantsLabel: No participants with activity in the selected period.
ExpenseReport.noSettlementsLabel: Everything is settled as of the end date.
ExpenseReport.noRecordedSettlementsLabel: No settlements recorded through the end date.

Mascot.noActionMessage: Nothing I can help with here right now.
Mascot.landingGreeting: Hi — I help split expenses once you sign in.
Mascot.hintReceiptVoice: I can fill an expense from a receipt or a voice note.
Mascot.hintSettle: Balances is where we settle up.
Mascot.hintSettings: You can change or turn me off in mascot settings.
Mascot.landingHintSplit: Split a dinner, a trip, or the rent — I’ll keep the math.
Mascot.landingHintSettle: When you’re ready to settle up, I’ll cheer you on.
Mascot.landingHintTap: Tap me anytime. I don’t bite — I’m a receipt.
Mascot.hintTapToAddExpense: I'm {name} — tap me to add an expense.
Mascot.hintTapToCreateGroup: I'm {name} — tap me to create a group.
Mascot.offlineMessage: I can't create anything while you're offline.

CreateSettlement.description: Review the payment before recording it.
CreateSettlement.successToastMultiple: Recorded {count} settlement payments as one entry

signup.title: Anonymous account
signup.description: Create a new anonymous account or use a saved sign in link.
signup.warning: Use Spliit without email, password, or social sign-in. Before you start, you will need to save a permanent sign in link.
signup.recoverDescription: Paste your complete saved sign in link to access it.
signup.recoveryOnlyHelp: New anonymous accounts are not available here. Paste your complete saved sign in link to continue.
signup.createError: The anonymous account could not be created. Please try again.
signup.recoverError: This sign in link is invalid. Check the complete link and try again.

onboarding.title: Save your sign in link
onboarding.description: This is the only way to get back into your anonymous account after signing out, clearing browser data, or moving to another device.
onboarding.unavailableTitle: Your sign in link cannot be displayed
onboarding.unavailableDescription: Generate a replacement link explicitly, then save it before continuing.
onboarding.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

recovery.warning: This link never expires or changes unless you replace it. Anyone who has it can access your anonymous account.
recovery.storedDataNote: Anonymous means the account is not connected to a sign-in identity. Your account data is still stored in Spliit Cloud.
recovery.howItWorks: Open the sign in link in any browser to access your account. In the installed PWA, choose Anonymous and paste the complete sign in link.
recovery.confirmation: I copied and safely stored my sign in link.
recovery.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the sign in link and copy it manually.

recover.title: Sign in to anonymous account
recover.description: Open your saved sign in link or paste the complete link below.
recover.howItWorks: A sign in link gives access to your account when opened in a browser. In the installed PWA, choose Anonymous and paste the complete saved link.
recover.invalid: This sign in link is invalid. Check the complete link and try again.
recover.switchDescription: You are already signed in. Continue to switch this browser to {name}.

settings.recoveryDescription: This anonymous account can only be accessed with your saved link. Open it in a browser, or choose Anonymous and paste the complete link in the installed PWA. The current link cannot be shown again.
settings.replaceDescription: Generate a replacement link to review and save. Your current sign in link keeps working until you activate the replacement.
settings.error: The sign in link could not be replaced. Please try again.
settings.activateDescription: Save the replacement link before activating it.
settings.stagedDescription: Your current sign in link keeps working until you activate this replacement. Closing or refreshing discards the replacement.
settings.replacementActivated: Your replacement sign in link is now active.

GroupViewLink.title: Public View-only link
GroupViewLink.description: Let anyone with this link view the group without signing in.
GroupViewLink.warning: This link provides view-only access to everything in the group. Share it only with people you trust.
GroupViewLink.enabledStatus: Anyone with this link can view the group.
GroupViewLink.replaceDialogDescription: The previous link will stop working immediately. Anyone who had it will lose view-only access.
GroupViewLink.removeDialogDescription: The current link will stop working immediately. Anyone who had it will lose view-only access.
GroupViewLink.replaceSuccess: Public View-only link replaced. The previous link no longer works.

OfflineEmptyState.title: You're offline
OfflineEmptyState.description: This screen needs a connection. Reconnect to load your groups and expenses.

PwaUpdate.title: New version available
PwaUpdate.description: Updating is strongly recommended because this version may no longer work correctly.
PwaUpdate.unsavedWarning: Restarting will discard unsaved changes in this window.
PwaUpdate.nextLaunchNote: If you choose Later, the update will be applied automatically the next time you launch Spliit.
PwaUpdate.restartFailed: Spliit couldn't restart. Close other app windows and try again.
PwaUpdate.otherClientsCountWarning: Other open Spliit tabs or windows detected: {count}. Close them to protect unsaved work, or restart all anyway.
PwaUpdate.clientCheckFailed: Spliit couldn't verify whether other tabs or windows are open. Retry, or restart all anyway.
PwaUpdate.forceDescription: Every open Spliit tab and window will reload. Any unsaved changes in them will be lost.
